name: Sidebar Thread Row
signature: Sidebar Thread Row(state: default|hover|active = default, title: text, time: text, project: text, machine: text) slots: chip
description: One thread in the sidebar list (sidebar-thread-row): h 52, 6px radius, px 8 py 6, gap 10; hover = secondary ground. Line 1 (h 20, gap 8): title text-base/20 at foreground 90% (100% on hover), fading out on the right, plus relative time text-xs muted-fg-1 tabular. Line 2 (h 16, gap 6, text-xs muted-fg-2): Project Chip at 80% opacity, project name, then machine glyph + machine name at 80% opacity.
usage: <doop-use component="Sidebar Thread Row" state="default" title="…" time="…" project="…"><template slot="chip">…</template></doop-use>
